name: Knight · Frost Warden
description: A northern guardian from the frozen peaks: pale ice-blue enamel plate with silver trim, a shaggy white wolf-fur mantle round his shoulders, an open helm with two swept-back silver wings over a small stern face with icy eyes, a round shield of blue ice carrying a glowing snowflake, and a crystal longsword held upright beside his head. He walks with the sword raised; his cut lifts the blade over the helm, sweeps it forward in a wide cold arc that sheds ice shards and snow, and brings it back to guard.
